clips.title: The story
paras: A Last Request begins upon discovering the corpse of a fallen peacekeeper in the field. Clutched in the dead guard's hands is a bloodstained note containing vital clues about his final moments. Reading his dying words offers the only way to carry out his unfinished duty and bring closure to his fate.

A Last Request begins with a grim discovery in the field: the lifeless body of a fallen peacekeeper. Slumped in death, the guardian still clutches a bloodstained note that slips free upon inspection. In these turbulent days on Zephras, peacekeepers often pay the ultimate price trying to maintain order, and recovering their dying words is frequently the only way to uncover what befell them.

The bloodied parchment pried from the peacekeeper's hands contains his final plea or instructions. Whoever ended the guard's life left his duty unfinished, leaving it to whoever finds the body to interpret the clues and see his final mission completed. Reading the note provides the critical direction needed to proceed and answer the fallen sentinel's dying call.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What news from the western watch?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.
I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
